_about: Promotions the posters work into existing slots (Alan 2026-11-15: 'Let's add the promotions to the posting on socials'). One promotion post a day per platform, in the first Reel slot at or after slot_from_ct (Central); the active promotions take turns by day. Volume does not go up. Copy rules: plain, concrete numbers, seller-first, never promise views or sales, never a category count; the clip's own question still ends the caption. A promotion posts only between start and end (Central dates, end exclusive) and only on its platforms. GUARD 2b (11-16): a promo line goes in this file only after its payout has one logged redemption. founding: held 11-16 to 11-18 (Guard 2b), released 11-18 after the live no-charge test logged the $29 discount (see the promo's released note); no end date since 11-20 (Alan: first 100 storefronts, no deadline; app PR #424 removed the Dec 1 checkout cutoff), so take it out when FOUNDINGDEALER is used up or switched off. storefront: the features turn for dealers (MESSAGING.md 11-21: same offer words as founding, no 'listing stays free' line for dealers, link yardswaps.com/s); it links /dealers without the founding query. share: the invite clause ('you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days') was held by Guard 11-16 and restored the same day after the share thread logged a real-database run of the referral cron code (GROWTH-LOG 2026-11-16); keep the words tied to the invited seller's first listing being live. reward_live stays false until the share thread confirms the $49 Stripe credit passed its sandbox test. lines_reward follow app PR #351: the reward comes one week after the invited person's first payment, and the 30 free days don't count as a payment. boost (11-17, Push paid boosts everywhere thread): paid listing boosts beside the free ones; prices from the live Stripe catalog; released 11-17 once the first paid boost was confirmed running. Never say a boost brings views or sales: only that it ranks ahead of unboosted listings in search and the home feed for the days paid.

promos.head: SHARE YOUR SELLER PAGE
lines: Your seller page is one link to everything you have listed. In the YardSwaps app, open Profile and tap Share my page, then text it to anyone asking what you have. Invite a seller with your invite link and you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days.

Open Profile in the YardSwaps app and tap Share my page. One link shows all your listings, so post it in your groups or send it to past customers. Sellers you invite get a free 7-day boost and so do you, once their first listing has been live 3 days.
lines_reward: Open Profile in the YardSwaps app and tap Share my page. The link carries your invite: when a seller signs up from it, you both get a free 7-day boost once their first listing has been live 3 days. If they pay for a storefront, you get a free month of yours one week after their first payment, or 5 free boosts if you don't have one. Their first 30 days are free and don't count as a payment.

Your seller page is one link to all your listings. Tap Share my page on your profile and send it around. Anyone who signs up from it is your invite. If they pay for a storefront, you get a free month of yours, or 5 free boosts if you don't have one, one week after their first payment. Their 30 free days come first and don't count.

promos.head: BOOST A LISTING
lines: Listing on YardSwaps is free. If you want a listing higher in search, tap Boost on it: 1 day $2.99, 3 days $7.99 or 7 days $14.99, one-time, no subscription. A boost puts it ahead of unboosted listings in search and the home feed for those days.

Every 4 listings you post earns a free 7-day boost, up to 5. Need one sooner? Tap Boost on your listing: 1 day $2.99, 3 days $7.99 or 7 days $14.99. It puts the listing ahead of unboosted ones in search and the home feed.

Has your listing been up a while? Tap Boost on it: 1 day $2.99, 3 days $7.99 or 7 days $14.99, a one-time charge. It shows ahead of unboosted listings in search and the home feed for those days. A free boost credit works the same way.
